title: Naruto
premise: Five great nations, each with a hidden village of shinobi. Chakra flows through everything. Where you stand in this world is your choice.

lore.title: Konohagakure
lore.text: The Hidden Leaf village in the Land of Fire, led by the Hokage. Home to the Uzumaki, Uchiha, and Hyuga clans. Its ninja academy trains genin, and the Chunin Exams are held here.

lore.title: Sunagakure
lore.text: The Hidden Sand village in the Land of Wind, built into the walls of a desert canyon. Led by the Kazekage. Its shinobi master Wind Release and sand manipulation, and water is always scarce.

lore.title: Kirigakure
lore.text: The Hidden Mist village in the Land of Water, wrapped in fog for most of the year. Its history includes the Bloody Mist era, when shinobi were bred and trained as weapons. Water Release is its signature.

lore.title: Kumogakure
lore.text: The Hidden Cloud village in the Land of Lightning, high in the mountains and led by the Raikage. Its shinobi are known for Lightning Release speed and strong close-range taijutsu.

lore.title: Iwagakure
lore.text: The Hidden Stone village in the Land of Earth, carved into mountain cliffs and led by the Tsuchikage. Its shinobi specialize in Earth Release, building fortress walls and heavy defensive jutsu.

lore.title: Akatsuki
lore.text: An S-rank criminal organization of rogue ninja who wear black cloaks with red clouds. They hunt the tailed beasts to extract them, seeking to revive the Ten-Tails. Members include Itachi, Pain, and Kakuzu.

lore.title: Uchiha Clan
lore.text: A powerful Konoha clan that awakens the Sharingan, a dojutsu that copies jutsu and reads movement. Its Mangekyo Sharingan is the clan's greatest power, and the main line was nearly wiped out in a single night.

lore.title: Hyuga Clan
lore.text: A Konoha clan that possesses the Byakugan, a dojutsu granting near-panoramic vision and chakra sight. Branch House members bear the caged bird seal, a binding mark that keeps them loyal to the Main House.

lore.title: Uzumaki Clan
lore.text: A clan from the fallen village of Uzushiogakure, known for vitality and enormous chakra reserves. After their home was destroyed, the surviving Uzumaki settled in Konoha and became a rare and prized bloodline.

lore.title: Chakra and Chakra Natures
lore.text: Life energy that blends physical and spiritual power, drawn from the body and nature. Five basic natures exist: Fire, Water, Wind, Earth, and Lightning. Combining natures yields Kekkei Genkai bloodline techniques.

lore.title: The Tailed Beasts
lore.text: Nine powerful demonic beasts sealed into human hosts called jinchuriki. Kurama is sealed in Naruto, and Shukaku was sealed in Gaara. Akatsuki hunt the beasts to extract their chakra.

lore.title: The Five Great Shinobi Nations
lore.text: Five major nations each host a hidden village: Leaf, Sand, Mist, Cloud, and Stone. Their shinobi serve as military assets, and fragile peace treaties keep the nations from open war.

lore.title: Chunin Exams
lore.text: A recurring multi-stage tournament held by each hidden village to promote genin to chunin. Stages test strategy, teamwork, and combat. Foreign village rivalries often surface during the exams.

lore.title: Jutsu System
lore.text: Techniques fall into Ninjutsu, Genjutsu, and Taijutsu. Hand seals guide chakra into a jutsu, and techniques like Shadow Clone multiply the user. Shinobi learn through training, scrolls, and copying.

lore.title: Naruto Uzumaki
lore.text: A Konoha ninja who carries Kurama, the Nine-Tails, sealed inside him. Son of the Fourth Hokage, he is known for persistence, the Rasengan, and a stubborn refusal to give up on anyone. He aims to become Hokage.

lore.title: Sasuke Uchiha
lore.text: The last surviving member of the main Uchiha line. A Sharingan user who left Konoha to gain the power needed to kill his brother Itachi. Rival and friend to Naruto, and bound to a dark path.

lore.title: Kakashi Hatake
lore.text: The Copy Ninja, a Konoha jonin with a Sharingan eye who has copied a vast library of jutsu. Former sensei of Team 7 with Naruto, Sasuke, and Sakura. Known for reading people and for the Chidori.

lore.title: Itachi Uchiha
lore.text: A prodigy who destroyed most of the Uchiha clan. A member of Akatsuki who served as a secret Konoha ANBU agent. Possessor of the Mangekyo Sharingan and the older brother of Sasuke.
